text: Databases store and organize information so we can find it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, which work well for structured data. NoSQL databases are more flexible and handle different data shapes. To get information from a database, we write queries, which are instructions that ask for specific data. Data modeling means planning how data connects before we build anything, which saves time later. Finally, indexes help the database find rows faster, like an index in a book. Good design makes databases fast and reliable.
